From: intake-referral@synthetic-referral.example
To: intake@synthetic-law.example
Date: July 2, 2026
Subject: Wage/hour packet with payroll and timekeeping exports

The attached synthetic wage/hour packet concerns Nora Alvarez and Riverbend Packaging LLC. The referral describes one single worksite, 18 hourly employees in the line-lead and packer groups, and a two-year lookback. The payroll export and timekeeping export summaries are included. The sender says expert and vendor needs are not identified yet and asks that any budget stay range-only pending human confirmation.

Synthetic demand summary: Nora Alvarez alleges unpaid overtime, meal-period premium issues, waiting-time penalties, and wage-statement violations against Riverbend Packaging LLC. The demand says the case is presented as an individual wage/hour claim and does not assert a class or collective action at intake, but that scope remains a human confirmation item.

Synthetic payroll export summary: the payroll export covers 52 pay periods for 18 hourly employees at one single worksite. It includes regular hours, overtime hours, meal-period premium flags, job codes, and wage rates for line leads and hourly packers. This is summary text only for synthetic budget-driver testing.

Synthetic timekeeping export summary: the timekeeping export covers the same 52 pay periods and 18 hourly employees. It identifies clock-in and clock-out records, meal-period punches, edits by two payroll custodians, and exception reports for the single worksite. Expert and vendor needs are not identified in this packet.
